## 3. Adapter Types — What Works

| Adapter | Requires | Result |
|---|---|---|
| `hermes_gateway` | Running gateway process for that agent | Only works if gateway exists. Without it → `error`. |
| `external_api` | None (directory entry) | Always `idle`. Cannot process issues. |
| `process` | Configured process runner | Always `error` — not configured. |

**Only Jericho's `hermes_gateway` with a live process can receive and process issues.**

### Routing Rule

Paperclip's Default Goal (`a66867b7-3310-4982-9c9b-48f9a83e770e`) has `routing: {}` but still enforces:
- Issues assigned to non-running agents → auto-reassigned to the only live `hermes_gateway` agent (Jericho)
- Status set to `blocked` when reassigned
- `blocked` issues without activity → auto-resolved to `done` after timeout

**The goal routing cannot be configured via API.** Agent PATCH/PUT/DELETE endpoints return 404.

## 5. The Working Pattern

Assign issues **directly to Jericho** with a `[lane]` tag in the title:

```
Donald → Paperclip API:
  POST /issues
  {
    "title": "[Research] Competitor pricing for AI agent SaaS",
    "assigneeAgentId": "20cb56be-0921-49c3-9bf0-ad32ce5420c5",
    "status": "todo",
    "priority": "medium"
  }
  → Jericho polls → detects [Research] tag → dispatches to fleet-research skill
  → result → Carlos via Telegram
```

### Lane Tag Convention

| Tag | Dispatches To | Skill |
|---|---|---|
| `[Research]` | Researcher profile | `fleet-research` |
| `[Analysis]` | Analyst profile | `fleet-analyst` |
| `[Sales]` | Donald | Donald's sales engine |
| `[DevOps]` | DEV | DEV's infrastructure skills |
| `[Design]` | Iris | Iris's design skills |
| `[Ops]` | PA | PA's ops skills |
| *(no tag)* | Jericho | Jericho's own processing |

## 8. API Limitations Discovered

| Endpoint | Method | Status |
|---|---|---|
| `GET /companies/:cid/agents` | List all | ✅ 200 |
| `POST /companies/:cid/agents` | Create | ✅ 201 |
| `PATCH /companies/:cid/agents/:id` | Update | ❌ 404 |
| `PUT /companies/:cid/agents/:id` | Update | ❌ 404 |
| `DELETE /companies/:cid/agents/:id` | Delete | ❌ 404 |
| `GET /companies/:cid/issues` | List all | ✅ 200 |
| `POST /companies/:cid/issues` | Create | ✅ 201 |
| `GET /companies/:cid/issues/:id` | Get one | ❌ 404 |
| `PATCH /companies/:cid/issues/:id` | Update one | ❌ 404 |
| `GET /companies/:cid/goals` | List goals | ✅ 200 |

Paperclip API is **create + list only** for agents and issues. No update or delete operations exposed.

## 10. Recommendations

1. **Route all Paperclip issues to Jericho** — use `[tag]` convention for lane dispatch. This is the only pattern that works without separate gateway processes.

2. **Don't create separate gateways for Researcher/Analyst** — they don't need Telegram bots. Jericho handles scheduled work (crons) and on-demand work (Paperclip issues) using their skills.

3. **Clean up zombie agents via Paperclip web UI** — the 4 orphaned agent entries can't be deleted via API. If Paperclip has a dashboard at `:3100`, it may allow cleanup.

4. **Document the `[tag]` convention** — add to fleet README so Donald/DEV/PA know how to invoke Researcher/Analyst via Paperclip.

5. **Monitor MAS-345** — the working test issue is `in_progress`. Let it process naturally and verify the end-to-end pipeline completes.
